title: 18/8 Stainless Steel Colander, Easy Grip Micro-Perforated 5-Quart Colander, Strainer with Riveted and Heat Resistant Handles, BPA Free. Great for Pasta, Noodles, Vegetables and Fruits
description:
About this item
Food Grade Stainless Steel 18/8 Construction: Our kitchen strainer is made of first class Stainless Steel 18/8 that is BPA free, Lead and Cadmium free. It is rust free and will never affect the taste of your food! Our heavy duty steel will never deform or bend as it’s 20% thicker than other colanders.
Riveted and Heat Resistant Handles: Our premium handles are riveted to the bowl so it will never come off! The non-slip elevated handles provide a firm comfortable grip. The plastic construction allows you to handle even the hottest pasta or noodles without a hassle.
Large Capacity to Strain Anything You Need: If you were searching for a spacious strainer that allows you to strain pasta, noodles, orzo, vegetables and fruits for your large family at one go, our colander is what you need. The 5-quart capacity makes this attractive even for small restaurants and food trucks.
Quick Draining Micro-Perforations: Tiny, closely spaced holes mean your food drains fast without having to tilt the bowl. The sturdy solid ring base keeps the colander from tipping over so that you can fill it up without fear of dumping your food.
Easy Cleaning: Simply set colander in the dishwasher for a fast, hygienic, and perfect cleaning. Even without a dishwasher, this colander is so easy to clean—just put it under running water and it will be as good a new, ready to be used again.
